worldcombat.skill.electrify.summary: Electrify another combatant so its next eligible move becomes Electric for the whole execution. Allies and enemies can both receive it.
The charge lasts up to %1$s s. The next eligible action consumes it on commitment and remains Electric for every segment, even if it misses. Requires an entity in range and line of sight.

Move typing, effectiveness and absorption settle normally. Native attacks are observed at their earliest damage delivery; one projectile shares the rewrite. Filter mode requires known Normal typing; Conduct All also supports other native attacks.
worldcombat.skill.electrify.allmoves.0: Conduct all: any non-Electric move becomes Electric, but duration -25% and cooldown +14 ticks, made to interrupt a key off-type move.
worldcombat.skill.electrify.allmoves.1: Filter: only Normal-type moves become Electric, but duration +25% and cooldown -14 ticks, cheaper and easier to leave parked on a foe.
worldcombat.skill.electrify.timing: Choose another combatant within %1$s blocks. Prepare %2$s s, spend %4$s PP, recover %3$s s; the %5$s s cooldown starts at commitment.
worldcombat.skill.electrify.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.electrify.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.electrify.preference.a: On = conduct all: any non-Electric move becomes Electric, duration -25%, cooldown +14 ticks. Off = filter: only Normal moves become Electric, duration +25%, cooldown -14 ticks. Rewrite scope and parked time trade off.
The companion only electrifies while a threat is within this distance; lower shoots up close, higher opens from range.
On "meet the attack", the companion waits until the foe is attacking it or its owner before electrifying, reading like a pre-emptive rewrite of that move.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to electrify a threat within range.
